name: Masonry
purpose: Arranges uneven-height children into responsive CSS columns without a fixed row grid.
scenarios: Display a gallery of mixed-height cards
Pack dashboard widgets of varying height

columns.description: Column count used at the large breakpoint (2, 3, or 4).

states.name: default
states.description: Columns follow the container query morph.

antiPatterns: Do not use Masonry for tabular data; use Table or DataGrid.
Do not force equal-height rows; that is Grid.

a11y.focus: Children remain focusable in source order, which may not match visual column order.

responsive.strategy: Root is a query container. Compact is one column; tablet is two; desktop uses the columns prop (3 or 4). No viewport size media.

breakpoints.large: Three or four columns at 80rem container width.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. CSS columns follow document direction.
